question.text: If for the series $a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots$. etc, $a_r-a_{r+1}$ bears a constant ratio with $a_r a_{r+1} ;$ then $a_1, a_2, a_3 \ldots$. are in

solution.text: Hint: $\frac{a_{\mathrm{r}}-a_{r+1}}{a_{\mathrm{r}} a_{r+1}}=K($ constant$) \Rightarrow \frac{1}{a_{\mathrm{r}+1}}-\frac{1}{a_{\mathrm{r}}}=K \quad \therefore \frac{1}{a_1}, \frac{1}{a_2}, \frac{1}{a_3}, \ldots \ldots$. is an A.P $\Rightarrow a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots$ is a H.P
